newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels bourse ends down as Christmas sets in.
newsitem.headline: Brussels bourse ends down as Christmas sets in.

text.p: 1550 GMT - Brussels Bel-20 leading share index closed lower on Monday as most investors left for Christmas holidays. Dealers expect index to stay quiet until new year.
* Retailer Delhaize closed up 0.82 percent at 1,855 francs with a volume of 122,400 shares traded after its U.S. unit Food Lion won a court case against ABC television.
* Bel-20 share index closed down 0.15 percent at 1,882.34 with a moderate 1.9 billion francs of Belgian shares traded.
* Electronics firm Barco fell 0.36 percent to 5,480 francs after its first day on the Bel-20 index.
